create table "public"."tasks" (
  "id" integer not null,
  "title" text not null,
  constraint "tasks_pkey" primary key ("id")

create trigger "tasks_after_delete" after delete on "public"."tasks" for each row when (old.title IS NOT NULL) execute function "public"."touch"()
create trigger "tasks_after_update" after update on "public"."tasks" for each row when (old.title IS DISTINCT FROM new.title) execute function "public"."touch"()
create trigger "tasks_before_insert" before insert on "public"."tasks" for each row when (new.title IS NOT NULL) execute function "public"."touch"()
